qualifying_updates.title: Public telemetry reports attempts against MLflow webhook-test SSRF
qualifying_updates.classification_detail: The public telemetry page reports observed exploitation attempts and a last-observed date, but explicitly does not establish that a target was vulnerable or that an attempt succeeded. It is not confirmed exploitation or demonstrated research.
qualifying_updates.affected_boundary: Internet-reachable MLflow Tracking Server webhook-test endpoint; the existing CVE covers redirect and DNS-rebinding SSRF to internal or cloud-metadata services before MLflow 3.15.0.
qualifying_updates.summary: A November 18 page update adds public sensor-telemetry claims of attempts targeting the disclosed MLflow SSRF. The claim does not provide successful-compromise proof, so it must remain explicitly unverified during later synthesis.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: MLflow product background belongs in ai-wiki. Retain the security-specific webhook SSRF, possible active targeting, network-egress, and cloud-metadata boundary locally.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: During ingest, seek corroboration from CISA, the MLflow maintainer, or independently attributable incident reporting before changing any status to confirmed exploitation.
